intro: December gives you more to photograph than any other month, which is exactly why Christmas dumps end up as forty near-identical tree photos. Use these 30 ideas as a shot list through the month, then pick 8 to 12 for the post.
Got the photos already? Jump to the 100 Christmas captions.

sections.h2: How to order a Christmas photo dump
sections.lead: Lead with light, follow the month or the day, and end on something warm or funny.

steps.title: Open with your best lights photo.
steps.text: It reads as Christmas instantly in the feed.

steps.title: Choose a frame: the month, or the day.
steps.text: A December recap runs from the first decorations to the last leftovers; a Christmas Day dump runs from morning to night.

steps.title: Alternate close and wide.
steps.text: An ornament, then the room; hands in dough, then the full table.

steps.title: Show people, not just things.
steps.text: One candid of each person matters more than ten decoration shots.

steps.title: End warm or funny.
steps.text: Someone asleep on the sofa, or the dog in a bow.

steps.title: Keep it to 8 to 12 slides.
steps.text: Instagram allows up to 20; save the longer version for your year in review.

faq.q: What should I post in a Christmas photo dump?
faq.a: A mix of lights, food, people and one or two funny moments. Close-ups and candids make it yours; one wide shot of your street or table tells people where you were.

faq.q: How do you make a Christmas photo dump look aesthetic?
faq.a: Shoot in warm light, get close, and let fairy lights blur in the background. Keep the colours consistent from slide to slide and avoid flash where you can.

faq.q: How many photos should a Christmas photo dump have?
faq.a: 8 to 12 for most dumps. Instagram allows up to 20 photos and videos in one carousel, which suits a full December recap.

faq.q: Should I post on Christmas Day or wait?
faq.a: Either works. Many people post that evening or the next day; others wait and post one December recap at the end of the month.

faq.q: What caption goes with a Christmas photo dump?
faq.a: Something short: cozy, funny or sweet. The 100 Christmas captions are grouped by mood, each with a Copy button.
